messages:
Maya R: quick FYI — ran `npm audit` after the pnpm upgrade, found multiple high/critical transitive issues in our UI build chain. see snippet below.

Jon P: can you paste the audit summary?

Maya R: ```
# npm audit report
Critical      tar 2.2.3  Arbitrary file write in extract
High          ssri 8.0.1  ReDoS in parsing
Moderate      hosted-git-info  info disclosure
Found 3 vulnerabilities (2 high, 1 moderate)
```

Carmen S: ugh, tar again. are these in devDeps or prod?

Maya R: mostly build toolchain (webpack loaders, terser, extractors) — technically devDeps but they live in our CI images and build containers.

Leo K: devDeps lower risk for runtime, but tar exploit can be used via CI artifact extraction -> supply chain. treat as high priority.

Sam (security-bot): CVSS estimate for tar vuln: 7.8 (high). Recommend immediate lockfile refresh + patch in build images. :warning:

Jon P: proposed plan: 1) pin/upgrade affected transitive packages in shrinkwrap/overrides, 2) regen lockfile with pnpm v8, 3) bump CI/build image, 4) run canary in staging, 5) prod roll after smoke pass.

Maya R: I'll open the PRs for the overrides + lockfile regen. heads-up: expect lockfile churn across several packages; will include clear changelog and test steps.

dependabot: created PR #9234 bump tar -> 2.2.4 (automerged: false)

Carmen S: good. avoid merging during Friday deploy window. target mid-week merge to give SRE time to monitor.

Leo K: also add a small e2e smoke job that verifies console UI bundles load and basic auth flows. prevents regressions from updated terser/config.

Maya R: will add the smoke job to the PR CI matrix. tagging @Jon P for canary monitoring.

Jon P: I'll provision a short-lived dedicated staging canary, enable detailed tracing, and watch error rate + bundle size diffs. if we see >1% error delta or big size bump, we rollback.

Carmen S: for compliance, ensure the PR notes KMS key usage when publishing artifacts and that audit logs will capture merges. we need a record for SOC review.

Sam (security-bot): checklist item: verify KMS key rotation status and that CI publishes artifacts using kms-key-v2. also capture PR merges in org audit logs.

Maya R: noted — I'll update the PR template with an "audit log & KMS" checklist and link the relevant playbook.

Jon P: timeline: PRs opened today, canary Wed 09:00, prod deploy Thu evening after traffic window. sound OK?

Carmen S: ack. I'll notify compliance and schedule a quick review if they want to sanity-check the KMS notes.

Leo K: one more: add a short rollback runbook to the PR description (commands to revert lockfile, clear pnpm store, and redeploy).

Maya R: will do. updating security tracker with CVE refs and PR links now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
